reviews.rationale: Sequential quarter-over-quarter comparison of selected displayed SEC rows only; no year-over-year inference, no guidance-versus-actual inference, and no complete-filing claim. The source-audited signed bridge shows the FTE net interest income change decomposes exactly into interest income, taxable-equivalent adjustment and interest expense movements; that is an accounting identity, not a causal driver, so no causal attribution is asserted. The non-GAAP FTE margin moved slightly lower while average earning assets grew, so the margin and level signals point in different directions and the mix explanation is not established by the extract. GAAP diluted EPS and rounded net income available to common rose sequentially, and the GAAP credit loss provision and reported net chargeoffs and chargeoff rate declined, which is directionally favorable on credit and earnings but is not evidence of a durable trend from one sequential pair. Noninterest income rose more than noninterest expense, but the extract does not identify the components, so fee mix and expense drivers remain unresolved. Basis differences (GAAP versus non-GAAP FTE versus reported operating) and rounded net income figures limit precision. Missing evidence includes full income statement and balance sheet detail, period-end versus average balances, allowance and reserve movements, segment and fee composition, capital and liquidity metrics, prior-year comparatives, and any forward guidance. Because the selected extract cannot resolve the margin-versus-volume tension or the driver composition, the research state is held for review rather than upgraded; the thesis remains blocked and no valuation or trading conclusion is drawn.
